Senior Java Developer, Covalent Infotech — Jan 2022 - Present

Built microservices with Spring Boot exposing REST APIs for reconciliation workflows; improved end-to-end latency by 35% through async processing and Kafka-based buffering. Containerized services with Docker and deployed on AWS EKS, using Kubernetes for scaling and fault tolerance. Implemented Hibernate-based data access to MySQL with optimized queries and indexing, reducing DB load by 40%. Maintained architecture docs and runbooks in Confluence.

Incorporated Apache Kafka for event-driven settlement pipelines, enabling near real-time settlement notifications and reducing reconciliation delays by 50%. Built Docker images and deployed services to AWS with automated CI/CD; used Hibernate for ORM and MySQL for transactional storage. Authored design and troubleshooting guides in Confluence.

Worked on performance tuning of SQL queries and transaction isolation to improve throughput. Collaborated with teams to document interfaces and runbooks in Confluence.
